name: visual-hierarchy
title: Visual Hierarchy
description: Review typography, spacing, hierarchy, composition, visual rhythm and contrast.
when_to_use: Whenever a design or build is reviewed.
instructions: Check that the most important element on every screen is unmistakable and that scanning order matches priority.
Check type scale consistency, spacing rhythm, alignment, grouping (proximity) and contrast between levels.
Cite selectors/sections and give the exact change (e.g. "raise h2 to 2rem, reduce section padding to 4rem").
